Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — security artifacts & outstanding pen-test asks

Hi Jared / FinHealth security team,

Following up from our MAP: attached is the current snapshot of outstanding security/compliance action items we agreed on during the evaluation. High-level status and asks this week: 

- SOC 2 evidence: we've uploaded most sysadmin runbooks and IAM screenshots. Still missing: rotation policy proof (owner: Karthik) and MFA enforcement logs (owner: Marissa). Please confirm whether the artifact format below (spreadsheet + PDF screenshots) is acceptable.
- DPA redlines: procurement flagged two clauses for legal; Vanessa has sent initial responses. Jared — if you can review the redlines document and drop comments, we'll prepare the updated DPA for signature.
- Audit logs retention: FinHealth requested 24 months; engineering can support 12 months now with roadmap to 24 months. Need confirmation on interim controls.
- Pen test scope: FinHealth to confirm external scope and whether code-level access (staging) is permitted. We have a proposed standard scoping doc attached.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Karthik: provide rotation policy artifact (ETA: 2026-11-24)
- Marissa: export MFA enforcement logs and upload to shared drive (ETA: 2026-11-23)
- Vanessa: circulate DPA redlines v2 and DocuSign link (in progress)
- Rishi: coordinate pen-test kickoff and share SUP ticket with FinHealth (ETA: target week of 11/29)

Attachments: finhealth_soc2_evidence_v3.xlsx, dpa_redlines_v2.docx, pen-test-scope.pdf

Proposed next check: Tue 2026-11-24 10:00 PT (30 min) — confirm or propose alternative.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Ops (Security Liaison)

Thanks for the clear tracker. Quick clarifications from our side:

- DPA: procurement will provide markup comments inline on dpa_redlines_v2.docx by 2026-11-23 EOD. We prefer a single updated DPA for signature after comments are incorporated.
